inspectedLocal.caption: The Kobe Port Tower in Kobe, Japan.
inspectedLocal.inspection: Inspected2019 original:32 straight vermilion steel members form open hourglass lattice, horizontal rings, visible white central circulation cage, five glazed upper floors flaring toward roof, three white lower levels and PORT OF KOBE roof lettering. Original controls preserved structural shape; post2024 glass rooftop/low terrace supplied separately.

inspectedLocal.inspection: Inspected2009 original: night-lit red lattice, white inner bracing, five upper glazed tiers and white tapering low base. Kiss FM building is a separate adjoining building and excluded. Night lighting colour is not used as daylight surface colour.

sources.inspection: Read technical feature with original designer/client/contractor interviews: upper diameter15m, lower25m,16 divisions with135-degree twist; open outer frame around central circulation cylinder; eaves99.1m, five observation levels and three lower floors; current lightning-tip108m. White internal/low/upper components contrast red exterior.
Primary original contractor text confirms32 straight sloping steel pipes create the hourglass silhouette; overall108m. Main members are straight, not authored as curved tubes.

Current operator text read:2024 renewal added glass-enclosed open-air roof deck and outdoor lower fourth-floor terrace; upper first observation floor75m. No old renovation wrap/scaffolding represented.

Operator roof-deck photo actually viewed in browser: open top, tall clear glass perimeter in silver/white vertical framing; adjacent full-tower view confirms retained red open lattice and white low base. Source pixels not downloaded or redistributed.

Operator lower fourth-floor terrace photo actually viewed: exposed red pipe lattice outside low glass guard, central white circulation cage, own terrace deck and white enclosed service return. Movable tables/chairs/parasols, branding and plant displays excluded.

Aerial context inspected: tower is wrapped for renovation in this imagery, so wrap silhouette is explicitly rejected. Circular tower at mapped anchor, adjoining northwest Kiss FM building, east road and west waterfront distinct. Generalized map tower envelope about26m matches primary25m frame base; entry orientation remains an approximation.

scopeDecision: Use preserved lattice with2024 structural glass rooftop and low terrace additions; reject aerial construction wrap and exclude adjoining Kiss FM building.
limitations: Preserved structural silhouette from selected2009/2019 originals with specific2024 operator rooftop/lower-terrace evidence. Renovation wrapping in aerial imagery explicitly excluded. No source photographic pixels redistributed.

Primary25m/15m diameters,99.1m eave height,108m lightning tip and32 straight members guide geometry. Tube gauges, intermediate rings, central bracing, exact window divisions, current glass guard heights and base entry position are authored estimates, not a construction survey.

Adjoining Kiss FM building, maritime museum, wider waterfront/pavements, exterior pedestrian bridge, movable terrace furniture/signs and interiors excluded. Own tower base/entry and structural terraces only. Independent native terrain will remain unchanged; contact requires current review.
